origin.description: Read a path and parse it.

arguments.name: simplify_vector
arguments.text: When true, record arrays become data frames.

origin.example:
tmp <- tempfile()
write_json(list(a = 1L), tmp)
cat(paste(readLines(tmp), collapse = "\n"), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Reads UTF-8 text and calls parse_json.

arguments.name: simplify_vector
arguments.text: When true, record arrays become data frames.

translation.details: The file is decoded as UTF-8.
translation.example:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from jsonlite import read_json, write_json
path = Path(tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".json")[1])
write_json({"a": 1}, path)
print(path.read_text().rstrip("\n"))
